factories.name: new_list_tasks_step
factories.description: List one bounded page of a project's or a section's tasks, optionally only incomplete tasks or tasks changed since a time, continuing with Asana's offset token.

inputSchema.description: ListTasksInput selects one page of tasks. Set exactly one of ProjectID and SectionID, and at most one of IsIncompleteOnly and CompletedSince.

completedSince.description: CompletedSince lists incomplete tasks plus tasks completed at or after this time.

modifiedSince.description: ModifiedSince lists only tasks that changed at or after this time. Asana counts assigning, renaming, completing, commenting on, or adding the task to a project as a change.

offset.description: Offset continues a previous list with the same filters; blank reads the first page. Asana expires offset tokens after some time.

pageSize.description: PageSize is the number of tasks to request, 1 to 100; zero requests 50.

projectId.description: ProjectID lists the tasks of this project gid.

sectionId.description: SectionID lists the tasks of this section gid.

factories.name: new_get_task_step
factories.description: Read one task by ID with its completion, assignee, dates, project and section memberships, plain-text notes, and custom field values.

taskId.description: TaskID is the task's gid, the number in its Asana URL, such as 1204567890123456.

factories.name: new_create_task_step
factories.description: Create one task in a project, optionally in a section, or in a workspace, with a name, plain-text notes, an assignee, a due date, and text, number, or enum custom field values.

CustomFieldValueInput.description: CustomFieldValueInput sets one custom field. Set exactly one of Text, Number, EnumOptionID, and MultiEnumOptionIDs, matching the field's type; other custom field types are not supported.

customFieldId.description: CustomFieldID is the custom field's gid.

enumOptionId.description: EnumOptionID selects an enum field's option by its gid, not its name.

multiEnumOptionIds.description: MultiEnumOptionIDs selects a multi-enum field's options by gid, replacing the current selection.

inputSchema.description: CreateTaskInput describes one task. Set exactly one of ProjectID and WorkspaceID; SectionID requires ProjectID.

assigneeId.description: AssigneeID assigns the task to me, a user gid, or the email address of a workspace member; blank leaves it unassigned.

customFields.description: CustomFields sets up to 20 text, number, enum, or multi-enum custom field values.

dueOn.description: DueOn is the due date as YYYY-MM-DD; blank sends none.

name.description: Name is the one-line task name, at most 1024 characters.

notes.description: Notes is the plain-text description, at most 65536 characters; blank sends none.

projectId.description: ProjectID adds the task to this project gid; its workspace becomes the task's workspace.

sectionId.description: SectionID places the task in this section of ProjectID; blank uses the project's default section.

workspaceId.description: WorkspaceID creates the task in this workspace gid without a project.

factories.name: new_update_task_step
factories.description: Complete or reopen, assign or unassign, reschedule, or set custom field values on one task, and move it to a section; every change is an absolute value, so a repeated update leaves the same task.

CustomFieldValueInput.description: CustomFieldValueInput sets one custom field. Set exactly one of Text, Number, EnumOptionID, and MultiEnumOptionIDs, matching the field's type; other custom field types are not supported.

customFieldId.description: CustomFieldID is the custom field's gid.

enumOptionId.description: EnumOptionID selects an enum field's option by its gid, not its name.

multiEnumOptionIds.description: MultiEnumOptionIDs selects a multi-enum field's options by gid, replacing the current selection.

inputSchema.description: UpdateTaskInput changes one task. Every set field is an absolute value, so sending the same update twice leaves the same task. Set at least one change.

assigneeId.description: AssigneeID assigns the task to me, a user gid, or a workspace member's email address; a pointer to "" unassigns it, and nil leaves the assignee.

customFields.description: CustomFields sets up to 20 text, number, enum, or multi-enum custom field values.

dueOn.description: DueOn sets the due date as YYYY-MM-DD; a pointer to "" clears it, and nil leaves it.

isCompleted.description: IsCompleted completes the task when true and reopens it when false; nil leaves it.

sectionId.description: SectionID moves the task to this section, removing it from the project's other sections; blank leaves its sections. Asana places a moved task at the top of the section.

factories.name: new_add_comment_step
factories.description: Add one plain-text comment, a comment story authored by the connection's user, to a task.

inputSchema.description: AddCommentInput describes one comment on one task.

text.description: Text is the plain-text comment, at most 65536 characters; line breaks are kept and the text is never read as markup.
